subject: Payroll didn't go out Friday
body: We approved the run on Wednesday like always and nobody got paid on Friday. The run still says processing. 14 people are waiting on their money.

subject: Need an off-cycle run for a final paycheck
body: An employee quit today and California says we have to pay her final wages right away. How do I run a single paycheck outside our normal schedule?

subject: Overtime paid at straight time
body: Two of our warehouse guys worked 46 hours last week but their checks paid every hour at the regular rate. The overtime multiplier didn't apply.

subject: Direct deposit landed a day late
body: Most of the team got paid Thursday but three employees at a credit union only saw it Friday afternoon. Is that on your side or the bank's?

subject: Printing paper checks
body: One of our employees doesn't have a bank account. Can we print a paper check from Tallyroll for her this pay period, and what check stock do we need?

subject: Bonus run gross amount wrong
body: I entered a $1,500 bonus for each sales rep in the bonus run but the preview shows $15,000 gross for one of them. I think I typed it right.

subject: Pay stub missing hours line
body: Our pay stubs used to show regular hours and the rate. This period they only show a total. Employees are asking how their pay was worked out.

subject: Change pay schedule to biweekly
body: We're moving from semi-monthly to biweekly starting next month. What happens to the run that's already scheduled for the 15th?

subject: Reverse a paycheck sent twice
body: Jordan was paid twice this period, once in the regular run and once in an off-cycle run I made by mistake. How do we get the second one back?

subject: Commission not included in the run
body: I added commissions for April as an earning type but they're not in the payroll preview at all. The run is due tomorrow.

subject: IRS notice for Q1 Form 941
body: We got a letter from the IRS saying our first quarter 941 deposits were short by $2,310 and there's a penalty. I thought you filed and paid that for us.

subject: W-2 has the wrong Social Security number
body: One employee's W-2 for last year has two digits swapped in the SSN. She needs a corrected form for her mortgage application.

subject: Register for Colorado withholding account
body: We hired our first remote employee in Denver. Do we need a Colorado withholding account before the first run, and can you register it?

subject: 1099s for contractors
body: When will 1099-NEC forms be sent to our five contractors, and do you file them with the IRS or do I?

subject: State unemployment rate changed
body: Texas sent us a new SUI rate for this year, 2.1% instead of 2.7%. Where do I update it so the next run uses it?

subject: Employee wants no federal tax withheld
body: An employee says she's exempt and wants no federal income tax taken out. Her W-4 in the system still has the old settings. How do we change it?

subject: Form 940 filed twice?
body: Our accountant says the annual 940 shows up twice in the IRS records for last year. Did Tallyroll file it as well as us?

subject: Penalty letter from New York
body: New York State sent a late filing penalty for the NYS-45 for Q3. We've been on Tallyroll since January so this should have been filed.

subject: Local tax for Philadelphia
body: Two employees live in Philadelphia. Their checks aren't taking out the city wage tax. Is that something we have to turn on?

subject: Need last year's W-3
body: Where can I download the W-3 transmittal that went with our W-2s? Our CPA asked for a copy.

subject: Add dental plan for the team
body: We want to start offering a dental plan from next month. Can Tallyroll set up the deduction and send enrolment to employees?

subject: 401(k) match not calculating
body: Our plan matches 50% up to 6% of pay, but the company match line on the last run is zero for everyone.

subject: Employee changed health plan mid-year
body: Priya had a baby and moved from employee-only to family coverage. Her deduction is still the old amount.

subject: COBRA notice for a former employee
body: We let someone go last week. Does Tallyroll send the COBRA notice, or do we have to do that ourselves?

subject: HSA contributions
body: How do we set up pre-tax HSA contributions for employees who are on our high-deductible plan?

subject: PTO accrual stopped
body: Our part-timers should accrue one hour of PTO for every 30 hours worked. Since March their balances haven't moved.

subject: Open enrolment dates
body: When does open enrolment start this year, and can employees make changes in the portal themselves?

subject: Roth 401(k) option
body: Two employees asked to split their retirement contribution between pre-tax and Roth. Does our plan in Tallyroll support that?

subject: FSA deduction too high
body: Marco elected $1,200 a year for his FSA but $100 is coming out every paycheck and we pay biweekly.

subject: Vision plan waiting period
body: New hires should get vision coverage after 60 days. A new hire from two weeks ago already has the deduction.

subject: Charged twice this month
body: Our card shows two Tallyroll charges of $186 on the 1st. We only have one company. Please refund the extra one.

subject: Upgrade to the Plus plan
body: We want next-day direct deposit, which I think is on Plus. What will it cost for 22 employees and when does it start?

subject: Invoice needs our VAT number
body: Our parent company in Ireland needs our Tallyroll invoices to show its VAT number. Can you add it and resend last month's?

subject: Why did our bill go up?
body: Our Tallyroll invoice went from $140 to $212 this month. We didn't hire anyone. What changed?

subject: Cancel our account
body: We're selling the business at the end of the month. How do we cancel Tallyroll and will we still get the year-end forms?

subject: Change the card on file
body: Our company card expires this week. Where do I put the new card so the subscription payment doesn't fail?

subject: Charged for a terminated employee
body: We were billed for 9 employees but one left in March and was terminated in Tallyroll. Shouldn't it be 8?

subject: Annual plan discount
body: Is there a discount if we pay for a year up front instead of monthly?

subject: Failed payment email
body: We got an email saying our payment to Tallyroll failed and the account will be paused. The bank says nothing was declined.

subject: Receipt for last payment
body: I need a receipt for the June subscription payment for our expense report. Where can I download it?

subject: Locked out after too many tries
body: I typed my password wrong a few times and now it says my account is locked. I need to approve payroll by 3pm.

subject: New phone, no 2FA codes
body: I got a new phone and my authenticator app didn't move over. I can't get past the code screen.

subject: Add our bookkeeper as an admin
body: How do I give our outside bookkeeper access to run reports without letting her change pay rates?

subject: Remove a former manager
body: Our old office manager left on bad terms and still has admin access. Please remove her right away.

subject: Employee portal invite never arrived
body: A new hire says she never got the email to set up her portal account. I've resent it twice.

subject: Set up Google sign-in
body: Can our team sign in to Tallyroll with their Google Workspace accounts instead of separate passwords?

subject: Password reset link expired
body: The reset link says it expired even though I clicked it two minutes after it arrived.

subject: Manager can see everyone's salary
body: A team lead told me she can see the pay of people outside her team. I only meant to let her approve timesheets.

subject: Change the account owner
body: The owner on our account is our founder, who left. How do we make the new CEO the owner?

subject: Employee can't log in to see pay stubs
body: An employee says the portal keeps saying wrong email or password, but she reset it yesterday.

subject: QuickBooks sync failing
body: Since Monday the QuickBooks Online connection shows an error and our payroll journal entries aren't posting.

subject: Map payroll accounts in Xero
body: When we connect Xero, where do we choose which accounts wages and taxes post to? Everything is going to one account.

subject: Hours from Homebase not importing
body: The Homebase timesheets for last week didn't come across into Tallyroll. Before, they showed up automatically.

subject: API key for our HR system
body: Our developer wants to read employee records from the Tallyroll API. How do we create an API key and what are the rate limits?

subject: Webhook not firing
body: We set up a webhook for payroll.completed but our endpoint never received it for the last two runs.

subject: Deputy integration duplicates employees
body: After connecting Deputy, three employees now appear twice in Tallyroll, once with each spelling of their name.

subject: Disconnect QuickBooks Desktop
body: We moved to QuickBooks Online. How do I disconnect the old Desktop company so nothing posts there?

subject: Class tracking in QuickBooks
body: Can the journal entries from Tallyroll be split by our QuickBooks classes for each location?

subject: API returns 401
body: Our script calling /v1/payrolls started returning 401 unauthorized this morning. We didn't change the key.

subject: When I Work time import rounding
body: Hours imported from When I Work are rounded to the nearest hour in Tallyroll. In When I Work they're to the minute.
